The dust-based $M_\mathrm{mol}$ is the least robust here, because of low S/N ($<2$) in all Herschel bands and the uncertainty in the dust SED fitting (cite: 2016A&A...587A..73B).

We caution that the current identification of galaxy 4 as a QG is only tentative. The assertion of the low SFR is based on very faint rest-frame UV fluxes and the obscured SFR of galaxy 4 is left not well constrained.
Obviously, current FIR and radio data are not deep enough to constrain galaxy 4’s SFR.
